name: Dr. Sarah Chen
bio: Dr. Sarah Chen is a board-certified developmental pediatrician with over 15 years of clinical experience. She specializes in early childhood development, behavioral interventions, and family-centered care.

reviewsData.text: Dr. Chen gave us practical strategies we could use the same day. Our toddler's sleep improved within a week.
Incredibly knowledgeable and kind. She listened to our concerns without judgment and guided us with evidence-based advice.
Very professional. The session was well-structured and we left with a clear action plan for our child's anxiety.

name: Dr. Marcus Rivera
bio: Dr. Marcus Rivera specializes in cognitive-behavioral therapy for children and adolescents. He has published extensively on anxiety disorders, emotional intelligence, and the impact of digital environments on developing minds.

reviewsData.text: Marcus helped our 9-year-old understand and manage anxiety in a way that felt empowering rather than clinical.
Great insights into how screen time affects attention. Would recommend for any parent concerned about digital habits.

name: Emily Watson
bio: Emily Watson is a certified pediatric sleep consultant with a background in neuroscience. She has supported over 800 families in establishing healthy, age-appropriate sleep patterns from newborn through preschool years.

reviewsData.text: Within 3 nights of following Emily's plan, our baby was sleeping 7-hour stretches. Life-changing advice.
Clear, compassionate, and incredibly practical. She understood our family's dynamics and adapted her recommendations perfectly.

name: Aisha Patel
bio: Aisha Patel brings over a decade of experience in early childhood education and family coaching. She specializes in positive discipline, emotional literacy, and building resilient family dynamics in multicultural households.

reviewsData.text: Aisha's approach to discipline changed how I interact with my toddler. We're both calmer and more connected.
She gave us language and strategies that work with our 4-year-old's strong personality. Highly recommend.

name: Dr. James Whitmore
bio: Dr. James Whitmore is a pediatric nutrition researcher and family wellness advisor. His work bridges the gap between nutritional science and practical family meal planning, with a focus on picky eating and food anxiety.

reviewsData.text: Dr. Whitmore turned our mealtime battles into peaceful family time. The meal framework he provided is simple and effective.

name: Nina Rodriguez
bio: Nina Rodriguez combines social work expertise with family wellness coaching. She helps parents navigate transitions, sibling dynamics, and the emotional demands of modern parenting with practical, heart-centered strategies.

reviewsData.text: Nina helped us prepare our 3-year-old for the new baby in a way that built excitement rather than anxiety.

name: Dr. Fatima Noor
bio: Dr. Fatima Noor studies the intersection of technology and child development. She provides families with evidence-based screen time strategies, digital literacy frameworks, and family tech agreements that grow with children.

reviewsData.text: Fatima gave us a clear, realistic framework for managing screen time without constant battles. Our kids actually helped create the agreement.

name: Dr. Thomas Blake
bio: Dr. Thomas Blake is a pediatric sleep medicine specialist with a clinical practice spanning newborns through adolescence. He integrates medical assessment with behavioral sleep interventions for lasting family rest.

reviewsData.text: Dr. Blake identified a medical component we had missed. Once addressed, sleep improved dramatically. Highly knowledgeable.
